```javascript
import { Pattern, Step, Rest } from 'strudel';

const kick = new Pattern([
  new Step(1), // Kick on beat 1
  new Rest(1), // Rest on beat 2
  new Rest(1), // Rest on beat 3
  new Step(1)  // Kick on beat 4
]);

const hiHat = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 1), // Hi-hat on every 16th note
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1),
  new Step(1, 1),
  new Rest(1)
]);

const bassline = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 2), // Bass on beat 1, holds for 2 steps
  new Rest(2),    // Rest for 2 steps
  new Step(1, 2), // Bass on beat 1, holds for 2 steps
  new Rest(2)     // Rest for 2 steps
]);

const lead = new Pattern([
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1), // Lead on beat 1, 0.25 duration, volume 1
  new Rest(3),          // Rest for 3 steps
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1), // Lead on beat 1, 0.25 duration, volume 1
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3),
  new Step(1, 0.25, 1),
  new Rest(3)
]);

kick.play();
hiHat.play({
  volume: 0.5, // Lower volume for hi-hats
  pan: 0.5     // Pan to center
});
bassline.play({
  volume: 0.8, // Slightly louder bassline
  pan: -0.5    // Pan to left
});
lead.play({
  volume: 0.5, // Slightly quieter lead
  pan: 0.5     // Pan to center
});
```
